🔥 The fire settles. Ines has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Greta says "We've been walking past those." Ronja mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🍽️ Ronja eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
The woods go silent — not quiet. Silent. Like the world holding its breath. The pack is already moving. They go quiet before the rush. If the birds stop, they're already moving.
The Hushpuppy stalks closer. The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing.
